models.name: Sparrow Base High-Res Mesh
models.description: Unrigged 16.9 MB high-polygon 3D cartoon sparrow character model created with Tripo3D v3.1 generative engine from authentic 2K concept art.
models.role: Source reference mesh for offline 3D rendering and texture baking

models.name: Sparrow Auto-Rigged Rest (T-Pose)
models.description: Auto-rigged base humanoid/avian armature with 42 joints, rest binding matrices, and vertex skinning weights.
models.role: Foundational rig for dynamic skeletal animations across all 15 SevaCare mascot states

models.name: Animation 1 — Reaching & Pointing (Wing Articulated)
models.description: Extended wing gesture pointing toward on-screen elements (e.g. prescription scan button, Today's Path node).

models.name: Animation 2 — Grounded Walking & Stride
models.description: Balanced leg stride pose representing continuous care progress and routine adherence.
models.role: Mapped to MascotState.DAILY_ROUTINE and Onboarding step progression

models.name: Animation 3 — Celebratory Hop & Wing Spread
models.description: Dynamic uplifted wings and elevated posture celebrating successfully taken medicine doses or verified safe notices.

models.name: Animation 4 — Attentive Listening & Head Tilt
models.description: Focused receptive posture with tilted head and forward-leaning spine, waiting for senior voice input.

models.name: Animation 5 — Welcoming Wave & Wing Flutter
models.description: Welcoming greeting flutter with open wings and joyful facial posture to reassure elder on app startup.
models.role: Mapped to MascotState.GREETING and App Launch Splash

models.name: Animation 6 — Protective Stand & Safety Alert
models.description: Firm upright protective posture with alert wings, guiding senior to pause during scam/urgent threat detection.
models.role: Mapped to MascotState.CONCERNED, MascotState.REMINDER, and MascotState.HELP_NEEDED
